name: Amirali Sarvestani
eyebrow: I design clear digital experiences for brands and product teams

about.label: About me
about.intro: I'm Amirali, a UI/UX designer with 4+ years of experience designing websites and digital products for brands, agencies and growing teams. I turn complex requirements into clear, thoughtful interfaces and use AI-driven workflows when they can make the visual experience stronger.
points: Research-led, from interviews to usability tests
Websites and digital products built around real business needs
AI-assisted visual workflows shaped around brand guidelines
Close collaboration with agencies, product teams and developers
headline: Designer by craft
Problem solver by nature

facts.title: Experience
facts.text: 4+ years of designing websites, landing pages and digital products across different industries and business models.

facts.title: End-to-end process
facts.text: From understanding the brief and structuring the experience to wireframes, polished UI and developer-ready handoff.

facts.title: Tools I use
facts.text: Figma, FigJam, Photoshop and AI tools for design, visual exploration and content production.

facts.title: How I work
facts.text: Clear communication, fast iteration and practical design decisions shaped around users, brands and business goals.
